segments.t: Are we doing dotcom Bowel 2.0 right now?
The AI build out relative to the TMT build out of 99,
2000 is multiples, even as a percent of the economy, GDP.
And an important thing to point out
is that when you get these CapEx booms in technology,
And there's a simple accounting reason why.
That is, when Tom buys chips for his data center from NVIDIA,
NVIDIA recognizes that as revenue and profit.
Tom capitalizes those expenses and writes them off
And so you have a mismatch where the same dollar in a CapEx
boom is recognized as profits by one entity
and deferred by the same people expending the dollar.
